content.content:
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Validate required fields first, so a missing/blank field is a 400 listing every
# offending field before the body is mapped to an entity.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validatePostcode

# Reject with 400 when a supplied postcode is malformed (not 4 digits) or out of range for the
# city's region. Absent postcode is accepted (optional). Runs after the required-field validation,
# so the city is known before its region range is applied.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidatePostcode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkCityCapacity

# Reject with 409 when the owner's city already contains 50 or more owners.
checkCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkDailyCreateLimit

# Reject with 429 when 100 or more owners have already been created today (by registrationDate).
checkDailyCreateLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerDailyCreateLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# When the body set 'sharesHousehold' true, assign the new owner and the existing
# same-lastName/same-address owner(s) a single stable, shared 'householdId'.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkIdentity

# Consolidated duplicate check: reject with 409 when the new owner's whole identityKey
# (normalizedTelephone|email|householdId) equals an existing owner's. Runs after the householdId
# has been assigned/back-filled (so it is part of the key) and before save (so the not-yet-saved
# owner is not compared against itself).
checkIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdMemberCount

# Count the owners in this owner's household (sharing 'householdId'), including this
# not-yet-saved owner. Runs after the shared householdId has been assigned and back-filled.
assignHouseholdMemberCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdMemberCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Record how many existing owners share this owner's firstName and lastName
# (case-insensitively), before it is saved so the count excludes it.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCode

# Assign the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code before saving: REGION from the postcode and
# HASH8 = SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName)[0:8] upper hex. A stable per-owner identity,
# so this no longer depends on the count of existing owners.
assignCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

# Set 'bulkSignupWarning' true when more than 80 owners were already created today (by the
# adjusted business-day registrationDate), before saving so the count excludes this owner.
assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT log line carrying the owner id, customerCode and registrationDate,
# after save so the generated id is available.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

      properties:
        type:

          title: Title

          example: NoResourceFoundException

          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true

          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

        - message

# Reject with 429 when 100 or more owners have already been created today (by registrationDate).
checkDailyCreateLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerDailyCreateLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# When the body set 'sharesHousehold' true, assign the new owner and the existing
# same-lastName/same-address owner(s) a single stable, shared 'householdId'.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkIdentity

# Consolidated duplicate check: reject with 409 when the new owner's whole identityKey
# (normalizedTelephone|email|householdId) equals an existing owner's. Runs after the householdId
# has been assigned/back-filled (so it is part of the key) and before save (so the not-yet-saved
# owner is not compared against itself).
checkIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdMemberCount

# Count the owners in this owner's household (sharing 'householdId'), including this
# not-yet-saved owner. Runs after the shared householdId has been assigned and back-filled.
assignHouseholdMemberCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdMemberCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Record how many existing owners share this owner's firstName and lastName
# (case-insensitively), before it is saved so the count excludes it.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCode

# Assign the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code before saving: REGION from the postcode and
# HASH8 = SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName)[0:8] upper hex. A stable per-owner identity,
# so this no longer depends on the count of existing owners.
assignCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

# Set 'bulkSignupWarning' true when more than 80 owners were already created today (by the
# adjusted business-day registrationDate), before saving so the count excludes this owner.
assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# after save so the generated id is available.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

## Summary

I implemented the soft-match (possible-duplicate) rule for `POST /api/owners`: when a new owner isn't a hard `identityKey` duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` and `postcode` with a *different* telephone, it's still created and flagged.

Changes:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added two read-only fields to the `Owner` schema: `possibleDuplicate` (boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (int32). These regenerate into `OwnerDto` at build time and map by name via MapStruct (no mapper change needed).

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — added persisted `@Column` fields `possibleDuplicate` / `possibleDuplicateOf` with getters/setters, mirroring how `bulkSignupWarning` / `namesakeCount` are stored so the values survive to a later `GET`.

3. **`AssignPossibleDuplicate.java`** (new function) — scans existing owners for a match on `lastName` (case-insensitive) + `postcode` with a differing normalized telephone; sets the flag and the matching id (earliest/lowest id when several match), else `false`/absent. It runs *after* `CheckOwnerIdentityUnique` (so hard duplicates are already rejected 409 and never reach it) and *before* `SaveOwner` (so it isn't compared against itself).

4. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new `assignPossibleDuplicate` step between `assignBulkSignupWarning` and `save`, under the transaction governance.

5. **Schema/data** — added `possible_duplicate` / `possible_duplicate_of` columns to all four `schema.sql` variants (hsqldb, h2, postgres, mysql) and appended the matching `NULL`s to the full-row `INSERT`s in hsqldb's `data.sql` (the only seed file using positional inserts that the test profile loads; h2/postgres use column-list inserts and were unaffected).

The new `Cp35Tests` passes and the full suite (48 tests) is green.
